misprints.note: The article at the start of the line has no rough breathing in the print.
Printed with a circumflex in Älskare.
ἐρώμενος means 'the beloved', not 'the lover'. This may be the compiler's error rather than the printer's.
The parentheses do not balance in the print.

uncertain.note: The first letter of the second line, 'χάς', is broken at the edge of the scan. I read it as χ from the sense.
The accent on ἢ is small and crossed with the breathing. I read it as a grave, so ἢν; the earlier text had ἤν.
The iota subscript under η is faint, possibly only the descender of η. I kept πῇ.
